Angel Investor: I invest money, but much more importantly, I invest time, experience and my network. I love ambitious founders, but I’m even more interested in humble ones. Curiosity beats certainty. Resilience beats perfection. Character beats almost everything else.  Impact Entrepreneur: Some of the projects I’m most proud of will never make headlines. I love strengthening local communities, supporting entrepreneurs, creating jobs and proving that business can be a genuine force for good.   Personally, I’m endlessly curious. Natalia and I spend months every year living in different countries, simply because changing your surroundings changes your perspective. Simple houses, long hikes, conversations with strangers and friends who become family.  The older I get, the less interested I am in titles and the more interested I am in people.
